content: संश्रि €1 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To have recourse to, resort, fly to for refuge or shelter. .²2 To lean or rest on, depend on; न खलु बहिरुपाधीन् प्रीतयः संश्रयन्ते <ls>U. 6. 12</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1. 24</ls>. .²3 To attain to, approach. .²4 To obtain; संश्रयत्येव तच्छीलं नरोऽल्पमपि वा बहु <ls>Ms. 10. 60</ls>. .²5 To serve, wait upon. .²6 To join, unite with. .²7 To approach for sexual union.
